blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Monday expressed confidence that the state prosecutors will secure victory on the P75-million plunder case that Sen. Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused former lawmaker Mike Defensor and two other businessmen are facing after their bail petitions were denied.
